items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well-, there was a guy with the Rose City Orchestra called Saxton. His real name was Will Parish.

ctx.x: SO IN OTHER WORDS, WHEN YOU WERE IN HIGH SCHOOL NOW, YOU HAD TO DEVELOP YOUR OWN STYLE BECAUSE I DON'T THINK THERE WAS ANYBODY ELSE AROUND THEN--NO OUTSTANDING TROMBONE PLAYER IN LITTLE ROCK WAS THERE AT THAT TIME.
Well-, there was a guy with the Rose City Orchestra called Saxton. His real name was Will Parish.
HE CAME HERE TO PLAY WITH CHICK WEBBLATER?
